labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks whether Rich can make text orange; Rich already supports orange color names, so this is a usage question.

items.body:
Rich already supports orange text. Pass a standard color name as the style, for example `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")`, or use markup such as `[orange1]Hello[/orange1]`. Other orange names include `dark_orange`, `orange3` and `orange_red1`. The full list is in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst and the style syntax is described in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst

If that does not do what you need, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) first, as the feature template asks.
